summary: 71-year-old Boulder resident with a lower-leg injury found near Cadillac Crags after passing hikers heard faint calls for help around 4:30 p.m.; carried out on a litter to the Visitors Center by Mountain View Fire Protection District and Rocky Mountain Rescue Group in a rescue lasting about four hours; transported to a Boulder-area hospital with non-life-threatening injuries.
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Mountain View Fire Protection District; Eldorado State Park
notes: BCSO case #23-02311. Sheriff press release date-pinned May 4, 2023; incident Wednesday May 3.
